newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metsa-Serla to focus on past purchases.
newsitem.headline: Metsa-Serla to focus on past purchases.

text.p: Metsaliitto, main owner of Finnish forestry group Metsa-Serla Oy, said on Tuesday Metsa-Serla would now concentrate on incorporating recent acquisitions, even though a significant chunk of the fine paper industry in central Europe is up for sale.

"We've got quite a lot of work with these (ones)," Antti Oksanen, CEO of the cooperative which holds a majority in Metsa-Serla, told a news conference after the company said it would buy part of Swiss paper maker Biber Holding AG.
He did not explicitly rule out further acquisitions, but said Metsa-Serla's recent purchases were strategically linked.
